rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the general state of being relative to something else.

example.english: This system shows the relativity of value judgments; there is no universally valid standard.
example.traditional: 呢個制度顯示價值判斷嘅相對性，唔存在放諸四海皆準嘅標準。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zai3 dou6 hin2 si6 gaa3 zik6 pun3 dyun3 ge3 soeng1 deoi3 sing3 m4 cyun4 zoi6 fong3 zyu1 sei3 hoi2 gaai1 zeon2 ge3 biu1 zeon2

rows.note: Use this for Einstein's physical theory, including special and general relativity.

example.english: In physics, relativity shows that time is affected by speed and gravity.
example.traditional: 物理學上嘅相對論指出，時間會受速度同重力影響。
example.jyutping: mat6 lei5 hok6 soeng6 ge3 soeng1 deoi3 leon6 zi2 ceot1 si4 gaan1 wui5 sau6 cuk1 dou6 tung4 cung5 lik6 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this for the comparison or evaluation side of sense 2, rather than for a measurable gap between things.

example.english: When choosing a school, relativity means you should compare which one best suits your needs.
example.traditional: 揀學校要有比較，因為邊間最好要視乎你嘅需要。
